plans.objective: Tracer slice for the Universal Backlog intent ledger (workstream `ub`, Phase 1): one item captured over

tasks.name: Task 1a (tracer 1/2): capture persists one item through the fsync barrier; a fresh instance reads it back
acceptanceCriteria: The syscall proof asserts the exact ordered array, with the directory entry conditional on the probe, and its fresh-instance case reads outcome `loaded` with a record deep-equal to the published one.
Grep for the regex `from ['"][^'"]*durable-file-write['"]` over non-test `.ts` files under `src/main/backlog` matches exactly one file: `backlog-record-file.ts`.

`config/durability-contracts.jsonc` contains `backlog.intent-ledger-record` with writer `src/main/backlog/backlog-record-file.ts` and tier `crash-durable`, in the same commit as `backlog-record-file.ts`.
No non-test `.ts` file in this task's `<files>` exceeds 300 counted lines (the oxlint max-lines rule passes over each).
`git show --stat HEAD` lists exactly this task's `<files>`.
tasks.done: A captured item crosses fsync before rename and a fresh instance reads it back; the durability gate is green at this commit; committed.

tasks.name: Task 1b (tracer 2/2): capture and read the same item over runtime RPC through the real RpcDispatcher
acceptanceCriteria: The roundtrip test's fresh-instance `backlog.get` returns outcome `loaded` with a record deep-equal to the one `backlog.capture` published, and the stored record has revision 1, `projectRefs` equal to `[]`, exactly one event of type `created`, and an id different from the forged `bli_forged`.
Grep finds `name: 'backlog.capture'` and `name: 'backlog.get'` in `src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/backlog.ts`, and `...BACKLOG_METHODS` in `src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/index.ts`.
Grep finds `setBacklogHost` and `getBacklogHost` in `src/main/runtime/orca-runtime.ts`.
`src/shared/protocol-version.ts` still declares the same `RUNTIME_PROTOCOL_VERSION` value as before the task (diff shows only the added capability constant and its comment).
No non-test `.ts` file in this task's `<files>` exceeds 300 counted lines (the oxlint max-lines rule passes over each new one).
`git show --stat HEAD` lists exactly this task's `<files>`, including `src/main/runtime/orca-runtime.ts` and `src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/index.ts`.
tasks.done: A real RpcDispatcher capture persists one item through the fsync barrier and a fresh instance reads it back over RPC; aperture and durability gates green; committed.

tasks.name: Task 2: wire the ledger into the process for desktop and headless serve, profile-scoped
acceptanceCriteria: Grep finds `setBacklogHost(getBacklogHost())` in `src/main/index.ts` and it appears after `setConversationHost(` in the file.
Grep finds `export function getOrcaBacklogDirectory` in `src/main/orca-profiles/profile-storage-paths.ts`.

Grep for `from 'electron'` or `from "electron"` across `src/main/backlog` returns no match in non-test files, and `src/main/ipc/backlog-host-wiring.ts` imports `getOrcaBacklogDirectory` and `ensureActiveOrcaProfile`.
Glob finds no `src/main/ipc/backlog-host.ts`.
The isolation test asserts the positive control (`loaded` in A) before the absence assertion in B.
The capability test asserts presence AND absence of `backlog.v1`.
tasks.done: Desktop and headless serve both expose the profile-scoped ledger through the runtime; capability advertised only with a host; committed.

plans.objective: Expand the tracer's persistence slice into a governed item lifecycle: pure ledger rules (transition

tasks.name: Task 1: pure ledger rules - lifecycle table, completion contracts, append-only events, link union
acceptanceCriteria: No non-test `.ts` file in this task's `<files>` exceeds 300 counted lines (the oxlint max-lines rule passes over each).
The lifecycle test asserts the total edge count is 52 and that `superseded` maps to an empty list.
The lifecycle test has at least one case per kind for `checkBacklogCompletion`, including a model-origin row that does not count.
The event-log test has one case per defect shape (drop, reorder, edited body with same id, duplicate id, zero appended, two appended) plus the valid single-append case.
The merge test asserts, for every generated pair, that the result length equals the count of distinct input identities and every input link identity is present.
Grep finds no `from 'node:` import in the three new shared modules.
Git log shows the RED test commit before the GREEN commit.
tasks.done: Lifecycle, event-log and link-union rules are pure, tested and committed RED then GREEN.

tasks.name: Task 2: fenced read-modify-write that refuses any event-log rewrite
acceptanceCriteria: No non-test `.ts` file in this task's `<files>` exceeds 300 counted lines (the oxlint max-lines rule passes over each).
The fence test asserts `{ outcome: 'superseded', expectedRevision: 1, actualRevision: 2 }` for the positioned competing write and reads the competitor's revision back from disk.
The fence test asserts the SHA-256 of the file is identical before and after each refused, unchanged, unreadable and schema-too-new case.
The fence test asserts `{ outcome: 'storage-failed', stage: 'publish', code: 'EPERM' }` for the rename failure, with a promise that resolves rather than rejects.
The syscall proof has a case whose expected log is exactly the single entry fsync:file.
Grep for the regex `from ['"][^'"]*durable-file-write['"]` over non-test `.ts` under `src/main/backlog` still matches exactly one file.
`config/durability-contracts.jsonc` backlog entry `provenBy` lists both the syscall proof and the durability test.
tasks.done: Mutate is fenced, append-only by construction, closed on every failure, proven at the syscall boundary; committed.

tasks.name: Task 3: update and transition an item over runtime RPC, one event per change
acceptanceCriteria: No non-test `.ts` file in this task's `<files>` exceeds 300 counted lines (the oxlint max-lines rule passes over each).
The events test iterates `BACKLOG_TRANSITIONS` itself (not a hand-copied list) and asserts it executed 52 legal cases and 80 illegal ordered pairs (12 x 11 = 132 distinct pairs minus 52).
Each legal case asserts exactly one appended event and revision + 1; each illegal case asserts the file SHA-256 is unchanged.
The round-trip test's fresh instance reads state `done` and 4 events (created, updated, transitioned, transitioned).
Grep finds `name: 'backlog.update'` and `name: 'backlog.transition'` in `src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/backlog.ts` and both names in `config/mobile-capability-aperture-baseline.txt`.
The RPC name-set test lists exactly four names.
tasks.done: Items can be updated and moved through the governed lifecycle over runtime RPC with exactly one event per change; committed.

plans.objective: Candidate intent and merges: idempotent candidate ingestion keyed by source fingerprint, the candidate

tasks.name: Task 1: idempotent candidate ingestion keyed by source fingerprint
acceptanceCriteria: No non-test `.ts` file in this task's `<files>` exceeds 300 counted lines (the oxlint max-lines rule passes over each).
The ingest test counts `.json` files in the candidates directory after the double ingest and after the 20-way concurrent ingest, and asserts 1 both times.
The concurrent test asserts the published count is exactly 1 and the unchanged count exactly 19.
Grep finds `createHash('sha256')` (or `createHash("sha256")`) in `src/main/backlog/backlog-identity-mint.ts`.
Grep for the regex `from ['"][^'"]*durable-file-write['"]` over non-test `.ts` under `src/main/backlog` still matches exactly one file.
tasks.done: Same source fingerprint always resolves to one candidate file, under repetition and concurrency; committed.

tasks.name: Task 2: candidate resolution and provenance-preserving item merge
acceptanceCriteria: No non-test `.ts` file in this task's `<files>` exceeds 300 counted lines (the oxlint max-lines rule passes over each).
The merge test includes a loser in state `done` and asserts refused `illegal-transition` with both files' SHA-256 unchanged.
The merge test asserts, after a successful merge, that every source-link identity and every execution-link identity from both inputs is present in the survivor exactly once.
The loser-failure test reads both files from disk and asserts the survivor holds the union while the loser's state is not superseded.
The accept-retry test asserts exactly one `.json` file in the items directory.
The accept-after-dismiss test asserts the items directory has no file for `mintItemIdForCandidate(candidateId)`.
The opposite-merge test uses `Promise.allSettled` with both calls and asserts both fulfilled.
tasks.done: Candidates resolve idempotently item-first; merges keep every link, survivor first; committed.

tasks.name: Task 3: ingest, resolve and merge over runtime RPC
acceptanceCriteria: No non-test `.ts` file in this task's `<files>` exceeds 300 counted lines (the oxlint max-lines rule passes over each).

Grep finds `name: 'backlog.candidates.ingest'`, `name: 'backlog.candidates.resolve'` and `name: 'backlog.merge'` in `src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/backlog.ts`, and all three names in the aperture baseline.
The RPC name-set test lists exactly seven names.
The fresh-instance assertion in the candidate round trip checks both source links carry the two candidate ids and the project ref mapping equals `inferred`.
tasks.done: Candidate ingest, resolution and item merge are reachable by desktop, CLI and paired runtime clients; committed.

plans.objective: Close Phase 1: open the whole ledger with per-record salvage, expose the read side (`backlog.list`,

tasks.name: Task 1: open the ledger with per-record salvage and project list / health from it
acceptanceCriteria: No non-test `.ts` file in this task's `<files>` exceeds 300 counted lines (the oxlint max-lines rule passes over each).
The salvage test asserts the set of quarantine codes equals exactly {not-json, id-mismatch, schema-too-new, invalid-name} and that quarantined length is 4.
The salvage test compares SHA-256 of every bad file before and after `openBacklogLedger` and after the refused update.
The salvage test asserts `{ outcome: 'storage-failed', stage: 'scan' }` for the file-in-place-of-directory case.
Grep finds `mapSettledWithConcurrency(` in `src/main/backlog/backlog-ledger-open.ts`.

The only `node:fs` or `node:fs/promises` import in `src/main/backlog/backlog-ledger-open.ts` names `readdir` alone (record bytes are read through `readBacklogRecordText`), and the module imports nothing from `durable-file-write`.
tasks.done: The ledger opens with per-record salvage and bounded reads; list, candidate list and health are real scans; committed.

tasks.name: Task 2: list, candidate list and health over runtime RPC - the full ten-method surface
acceptanceCriteria: No non-test `.ts` file in this task's `<files>` exceeds 300 counted lines (the oxlint max-lines rule passes over each).
Grep for `name: 'backlog\.` in `src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/backlog.ts` counts exactly 10 matches.
Grep for `^backlog\.` in `config/mobile-capability-aperture-baseline.txt` counts exactly 10 lines.
The name-set test lists exactly ten names and compares sorted arrays for equality.
The round trip reads through a FRESH service, runtime and dispatcher, not the one that wrote.
tasks.done: The full ten-method ledger surface is reachable and fail-closed; committed.

tasks.name: Task 3: mutation drills M1-M6 and the phase gates, bracketed by the dirty-path set
acceptanceCriteria: `01-04-SUMMARY.md` contains a drill table with six rows M1..M6, each with a pre-plant and a post-restore SHA-256 that are equal, and each recorded CAUGHT (any SURVIVED row must be followed by a test-only strengthening commit and a CAUGHT re-run row).
The M1 row records the exit code of `pnpm run check:durability-contracts` observed while the plant was in place; the M6 row names both ingest cases that turned red.
`01-04-SUMMARY.md` contains a gate table with the exit code and log path of every command in step C.2 and the before/after dirty-set comparison, and lists T-01-12 as open for Phase 7.
No commit made by this task touches a non-test file under `src/` (strengthening commits touch test files only); the porcelain check over the five drilled files prints nothing at the end.
`01-VALIDATION.md` rows are marked green only where the SUMMARY's gate table shows exit 0.
tasks.done: Every drill bit and was restored byte-for-byte; the phase gates are recorded with their exit codes and tree-movement bracket; Phase 1 closes at the stated rung.
